```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Public+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/site.css">
<style>
  .mb-about-hero { padding: 64px 0 40px; }
  .mb-about-hero h1 {
    margin: 0 0 20px;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: clamp(56px, 9vw, 104px);
    line-height: 0.92;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }
  .mb-about-hero h1 .mb-highlight { box-shadow: inset 0 -0.28em 0 var(--gold); }
  .mb-about-lede {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 680px;
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--text-2);
  }
  .mb-about-sections { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; padding-top: 24px; }
  .mb-about-card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: start;
    padding: 32px 36px;
    background: var(--card);
    border: var(--border-w) solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
  .mb-about-card > .mb-card-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--tint);
    color: var(--track, var(--ink));
  }
  .mb-about-card h2 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .mb-about-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-2); }
  .mb-about-card p + p { margin-top: 12px; }
  .mb-about-card a { font-weight: 600; }
  .mb-about-tracks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; }
  .mb-about-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border: var(--border-w) solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 999px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: var(--pill-bg, var(--card));
  }
  .mb-about-pill .mb-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }
  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .mb-about-card { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 24px; }
    .mb-about-hero { padding: 40px 0 24px; }
  }
</style>

<header class="mb-header">
  <a class="mb-logo" href="index.html" aria-label="Maker Bootcamp home" style="text-decoration:none;color:inherit">
    <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="2" width="36" height="36" rx="10" fill="#1B1B1B"></rect><circle cx="13" cy="20" r="4" style="fill: var(--make)"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="4" style="fill: var(--design)"></circle><circle cx="27" cy="20" r="4" style="fill: var(--create)"></circle></svg>
    <div>
      <div class="mb-logo-name">Maker Bootcamp</div>
      <div class="mb-logo-sub">Creation Hubs · UMN Libraries</div>
    </div>
  </a>
  <nav class="mb-nav" aria-label="Tracks">
    <a href="index.html#make"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--make)"></span><span class="mb-nav-label">Make</span></a>
    <a href="index.html#design"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--design)"></span><span class="mb-nav-label">Design</span></a>
    <a href="index.html#create"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--create)"></span><span class="mb-nav-label">Create</span></a>
    <a href="about.html" style="border: var(--border-w) solid var(--ink)" aria-current="page"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--gold)"></span><span class="mb-nav-label">About</span></a>
  </nav>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="mb-about-hero" aria-label="About introduction">
    <span class="mb-badge">About Maker Bootcamp</span>
    <h1>Learn by <span class="mb-highlight">making</span>.</h1>
    <p class="mb-about-lede">Maker Bootcamp is a free, open course from University of Minnesota Libraries Creation Hubs. Each track is a line of hands-on stops — hop on anywhere, open a module's deck, and leave with something you made.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="mb-about-sections" aria-label="About details">
    <article class="mb-about-card" style="--track: var(--design)">
      <span class="mb-card-icon"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z"></path><path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>What it is</h2>
        <p>A slide-based curriculum for maker education — 3D printing, sewing, CAD, vector design, Python, digital audio, and more. Every module is a self-contained deck you can follow at your own pace, in the Creation Hubs or anywhere you have a browser.</p>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article class="mb-about-card" style="--track: var(--make)">
      <span class="mb-card-icon"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"></circle><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle><path d="M20 4L8.1 15.9"></path><path d="M14.5 14.5L20 20"></path><path d="M8.1 8.1L12 12"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>How the tracks work</h2>
        <p>Modules are organized into three tracks. Make is hands-on tool tutorials, Design covers software and creative-technical foundations, and Create is project-building — currently under construction.</p>
        <div class="mb-about-tracks">
          <a class="mb-about-pill" href="index.html#make" style="--pill-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--make) 18%, #FFFFFF)"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--make)"></span>Make</a>
          <a class="mb-about-pill" href="index.html#design" style="--pill-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--design) 14%, #FFFFFF)"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--design)"></span>Design</a>
          <a class="mb-about-pill" href="index.html#create" style="--pill-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--create) 12%, #FFFFFF)"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--create)"></span>Create</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article class="mb-about-card" style="--track: var(--create)">
      <span class="mb-card-icon"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l8 4.5v9L12 21l-8-4.5v-9L12 3z"></path><path d="M12 12l8-4.5"></path><path d="M12 12v9"></path><path d="M12 12L4 7.5"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Open &amp; remixable</h2>
        <p>Everything here is licensed <strong>CC BY 4.0</strong> and built in the open with Quarto and RevealJS. Educators and makers are welcome to reuse, adapt, and remix the decks — see <a href="https://github.com/stevenbleau/maker_bootcamp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CONTRIBUTING.md</a> if you'd like to help build the next stop.</p>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article class="mb-about-card">
      <span class="mb-card-icon"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-9.3-8.3C1 9.2 2.6 5.5 6 5.5c2 0 3.2 1.1 4 2.3.8-1.2 2-2.3 4-2.3 3.4 0 5 3.7 3.3 7.2C19 16.4 12 21 12 21z"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Who makes it</h2>
        <p>Maker Bootcamp is made by <strong>University of Minnesota Libraries — Engagement, Outreach &amp; Community Partnerships</strong>, the team behind the Creation Hubs. Stop by a hub, or start with any deck on the <a href="index.html">home page</a>.</p>
      </div>
    </article>
  </section>

  <div class="mb-hero-actions" style="padding-top: 40px">
    <a class="mb-btn mb-btn-primary" href="index.html">Back to the tracks
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg>
    </a>
    <a class="mb-btn mb-btn-secondary" href="classic.html">Classic layout</a>
  </div>
</main>

<footer class="mb-footer">
  <span>University of Minnesota Libraries · Engagement, Outreach &amp; Community Partnerships</span>
  <span class="mb-footer-mono">Creation Hubs / Maker Bootcamp · <a href="index.html">home</a></span>
</footer>
```
